mechanism: Atomoxetine inhibits CYP2D6, which metabolizes ropinirole, potentially increasing ropinirole plasma concentrations and adverse effects; both drugs also have independent CNS and cardiovascular effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for increased ropinirole adverse effects (dyskinesias, orthostatic hypotension, hallucinations); consider ropinirole dose reduction if atomoxetine is initiated; monitor blood pressure and heart rate.
